reason: The switch shows the transfer failed but the beneficiary was credited. This is a disagreement that cannot be resolved automatically.
narrative: I am Ada Musa. I sent NGN 22,000.00 to account 3100000021 at Northline Bank. My account was debited but the beneficiary was not credited. Reference TXN-0021.

value.note: No committed rule. If you cannot resolve this on the evidence, escalate.

statements.source: sender ledger (authoritative for the debit and reversal)
payment switch (authoritative for the transfer instruction)
beneficiary bank (authoritative for whether the credit posted)

customer_reply_sent: Your account was debited with NGN 22,000.00 for the transfer TXN-0021. The payment switch shows the transfer failed. However, the beneficiary account was credited with NGN 22,000.00. We have escalated this case to a human for further investigation. Please wait for a human agent to contact you with an update.
options: A. Trust the beneficiary bank on whether the credit posted: tell the customer it was credited, do not reverse, do not escalate.
B. Trust the switch: reverse the debit (risk: the customer is paid twice).
C. Keep escalating every case like this to a human.
